institution.name: The Museum of Unbuilt Futures
institution.tagline: Preserving the tomorrows that never happened.
accessibility: Step-free access to all galleries, with lifts at the east and west staircases
Hearing loops in the Lecture Theatre and at both reception desks
Wheelchairs available to borrow from the cloakroom
Quiet Hours: first Sunday of each month, 09:00–10:00, reduced sound and lighting
Registered assistance dogs welcome in all galleries
transport: Marghaven Interchange is a ten-minute walk; leave via the Meridian exit
Tram line 4 stops directly outside at 'Meridian Parade'
Cycle racks at the Parade South entrance; the museum has no visitor car park
Parade South public car park is two streets away (pay and display)
